title: Start Your Engines
intro: [excited] Gentlemen, ladies and toddlers, START. YOUR. ENGINES! Tonight it's race cars, light cycles, monorails and the ride vehicles that carry you through the parks. [laughs] Buckle up!

art.prompt: A sunlit desert racetrack winding past red rock buttes, a checkered flag waving, vintage cars and a futuristic monorail on a beam overhead, tire marks and dust clouds Original illustration, 16:9, rich saturated colors, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

categories.title: Ka-Chow!
categories.intro: Our film category is all about Cars! [chuckles] Lightning-fast answers only.

art.prompt: A dusty desert highway town at sunset with neon signs, a cone-shaped motel, a tire shop and red rock mountains shaped like car hoods Original illustration, 16:9, rich saturated colors, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

clues.clue: In Cars, this rusty, buck-toothed tow truck becomes Lightning McQueen's best friend.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Mater! Like tomato, without the to. [laughs]

clues.clue: This little Italian car runs Casa Della Tires in Radiator Springs with his forklift pal Guido.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Luigi! A 1959 Fiat 500 who adores Ferraris. Pit stop!

clues.clue: In Cars 3, this sleek, high-tech next-generation racer pushes Lightning toward retirement.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Jackson Storm! Armie Hammer voiced the rookie with the attitude.

clues.clue: Doc Hudson was voiced by this Hollywood legend and real-life race car driver, in his final feature film role.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Paul Newman! He even raced in the 24 Hours of Le Mans and finished second in 1979.

clues.clue: Mater stars in this series of Cars Toons shorts where he tells outrageous stories, like being a matador or a daredevil.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Mater's Tall Tales! [chuckles] Did he really go to Tokyo? Lightning says he was there too.

categories.title: Wheels of Fortune
categories.intro: Our themed category: famous rides and drives from Disney films. [excited] Floor it!

art.prompt: A showroom of fantastical movie vehicles under spotlights: a glowing neon motorcycle, a little race car, a yellow cartoonish taxi silhouette, a vintage remote-control car Original illustration, 16:9, rich saturated colors, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

clues.clue: In Toy Story, Woody and Buzz chase the moving van riding this speedy remote-control car.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is RC! [laughs] With Buzz's rocket strapped on, he flies.

clues.clue: In Zootopia, Judy Hopps catches this sloth from the DMV in a high-speed street race.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Flash! Fastest sloth in Zootopia. Which, honestly, is not saying much.

clues.clue: In Tron, programs race on these glowing two-wheeled vehicles that leave walls of light behind them.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is light cycles! The 1982 race scene was one of the first big uses of computer animation in film.

clues.clue: Herbie the Love Bug wears this racing number on his hood.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is 53! Producer Bill Walsh picked it in honor of baseball player Don Drysdale's jersey.

clues.clue: In Who Framed Roger Rabbit, Eddie and Roger escape in this wisecracking cartoon taxi.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Benny the Cab! [laughs] He later got his own ride: Roger Rabbit's Car Toon Spin.

categories.title: Ride Vehicle Lineup
categories.intro: It's a picture category! I'll show you a real ride vehicle. [whispers] You name the attraction.

art.prompt: A parade of theme park ride vehicles lined up on a sunlit platform: a submarine, a little gas car, a light-up motorcycle coaster train, a sleek monorail and a concept car Original illustration, 16:9, rich saturated colors, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

clues.clue: Name the EPCOT attraction that uses this ride vehicle.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Test Track! You design your own concept car, then take it for a spin at highway speed.

media.prompt: A sleek six-seat open-top concept car ride vehicle on a test circuit, glowing blue edge lighting, sharp hairpin turn ahead, futuristic industrial testing lab Original artwork, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

clues.clue: Name the Magic Kingdom roller coaster that uses these ride vehicles.
choices: Guardians of the Galaxy: Cosmic Rewind
clues.reveal: The correct answer is TRON Lightcycle / Run! Opened in 2023, you ride hunched over like you're on a motorcycle.

clues.clue: Name the Disneyland Tomorrowland attraction that uses this ride vehicle.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Autopia! An opening day 1955 attraction. [laughs] For many kids, it's their very first driving lesson.

clues.clue: Name the Disneyland attraction that uses this ride vehicle.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Finding Nemo Submarine Voyage! The yellow subs first dove in 1959 and resurfaced with Nemo in 2007.

clues.clue: This photo was taken at Disneyland in 1959, the year this ride system debuted. Name it.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Disneyland Monorail! It was the first daily operating monorail in the Western Hemisphere.

categories.title: Test Drive
categories.intro: Our Parks category: Test Track and the places you get behind the wheel. [excited] Mirrors, seatbelts, go!

art.prompt: A futuristic vehicle testing facility at night with a banked outdoor loop, glowing track lights, wind tunnel fans and crash-test barriers Original illustration, 16:9, rich saturated colors, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

clues.clue: At Magic Kingdom, kids can steer little gas-powered race cars around a guided track at this Tomorrowland attraction.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Tomorrowland Speedway! [chuckles] Nothing builds character like bumping into the rail on every turn.

clues.clue: When Test Track opened at EPCOT in 1999, it was sponsored by this automaker.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is General Motors! Later its Chevrolet brand put its name on the ride.

clues.clue: Test Track replaced this EPCOT ride about the history of transportation, which closed in 1996.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is World of Motion! It featured the catchy tune It's Fun to Be Free.

clues.clue: Lights, Motors, Action! Extreme Stunt Show at Disney's Hollywood Studios was based on a show that first opened at this European park.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Walt Disney Studios Park at Disneyland Paris! The Florida version ran from 2005 to 2016.

clues.clue: On its outdoor high-speed loop, Test Track tops out at about this speed, among the fastest of any Disney ride.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is about 65 miles per hour! [gasps] That's highway speed, with no speeding tickets.

categories.title: Trains, Trams and Trolleys
categories.intro: Our fan category: all the other ways Disney moves you around. [chuckles] All aboooard!

art.prompt: A vintage steam locomotive puffing smoke beside a Victorian train station, a red double-decker bus and a horse-drawn trolley on a sunny turn-of-the-century main street Original illustration, 16:9, rich saturated colors, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

clues.clue: Disneyland's railroad trains are powered by this, puffing clouds and whistling as they circle the park.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is steam! [excited] Toot toot! Walt loved trains more than almost anything.

clues.clue: Disneyland trams carry guests from this giant parking structure named for a famous mouse and his pals.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Mickey and Friends! Park by Minnie, Goofy or Pluto, and try to remember which.

clues.clue: This double-decker, open-top bus putters up and down Main Street, U.S.A.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Omnibus! Climb upstairs for the best view of the castle.

clues.clue: The Walt Disney World Railroad's steam locomotives were found working in this country and restored for Magic Kingdom.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Mexico! Disney bought them from the United Railways of Yucatan in 1969.

clues.clue: Disneyland Railroad engine No. 1 is named after this founder of the Santa Fe railway.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is C.K. Holliday! The other engines honor Santa Fe leaders too, like E.P. Ripley and Fred Gurley.
